title: n8n System Tasks (InfluxDB)
description: Is every n8n system task running? Late or failing tasks show in red.

links.title: n8n Durable Scheduler
links.tooltip: The scheduler that runs durable system tasks

list.name: task
list.label: System task
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(
  bucket: "${bucket}",
  tag: "task",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and r._field == "n8n_system_task_info",
  start: v.timeRangeStart,
  stop: v.timeRangeStop,
)

list.name: instance
list.label: Main instance
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(
  bucket: "${bucket}",
  tag: "url",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and r._field == "n8n_system_task_info",
  start: v.timeRangeStart,
  stop: v.timeRangeStop,
)

panels.title: Late Tasks
panels.description:
Tasks that stopped running. A task is late when its last success is older than two of its intervals, with the interval counted as at least 60 seconds. A task with no success reported in the last 2 days is also late.

Bad when: above zero. Find the task in the table below.

targets.query:
import "array"

every = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > int(v: 1m) then v.windowPeriod else 1m

info = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and (r._field == "n8n_system_task_info"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["task"], set: ${task:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["url"], set: ${instance:json}))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({task: r.task, kind: "info", v: 1.0, mode: r.mode}))

interval = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and (r._field == "n8n_system_task_interval_seconds"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["task"], set: ${task:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["url"], set: ${instance:json}))
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["task"])
  |> max()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({task: r.task, kind: "interval", v: r._value, mode: ""}))

lastok = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -2d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and (r._field == "n8n_system_task_last_success_timestamp_seconds"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["task"], set: ${task:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["url"], set: ${instance:json}))
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["task"])
  |> max()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({task: r.task, kind: "last", v: r._value, mode: ""}))

runsok = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and (r._field == "n8n_system_task_run_duration_seconds_count") and r.result == "success")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["task"], set: ${task:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["url"], set: ${instance:json}))
  |> increase()
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["task"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({task: r.task, kind: "ok", v: r._value, mode: ""}))

runsfail = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and (r._field == "n8n_system_task_run_duration_seconds_count") and r.result == "failure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["task"], set: ${task:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["url"], set: ${instance:json}))
  |> increase()
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["task"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({task: r.task, kind: "fail", v: r._value, mode: ""}))

sched = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and (r._field == "n8n_system_task_scheduled"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["task"], set: ${task:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["url"], set: ${instance:json}))
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["task"])
  |> min()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({task: r.task, kind: "sched", v: r._value, mode: ""}))

tbl = union(tables: [info, interval, lastok, runsok, runsfail, sched])
  |> group(columns: ["task"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {mode: "", info: 0.0, interval: 0.0, last: 0.0, ok: 0.0, fail: 0.0, sched: -1.0},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      mode: if r.kind == "info" then r.mode else accumulator.mode,
      info: if r.kind == "info" then 1.0 else accumulator.info,
      interval: if r.kind == "interval" then r.v else accumulator.interval,
      last: if r.kind == "last" then r.v else accumulator.last,
      ok: if r.kind == "ok" then r.v else accumulator.ok,
      fail: if r.kind == "fail" then r.v else accumulator.fail,
      sched: if r.kind == "sched" then r.v else accumulator.sched,
    }),
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.info == 1.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
    since = float(v: int(v: now())) / 1000000000.0 - r.last
    window = if r.interval > 60.0 then r.interval else 60.0
    return {
      task: r.task,
      mode: r.mode,
      "Scheduled": r.sched,
      "Interval": r.interval,
      "Last success": if r.last > 0.0 then since else -1.0,
      "Late factor": if r.last > 0.0 then since / window else 1000000000.0,
      "Runs": r.ok,
      "Failures": r.fail,
    }
  })
  |> group()

union(tables: [
  tbl
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Late factor"] > 2.0)
    |> group()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: 1.0}))
    |> keep(columns: ["_value"]),
  array.from(rows: [{_value: 0.0}]),
])
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Late Tasks"})

panels.description:

Bad when: above zero. Find the task on Failed Runs per Task, then read its error in the logs.

panels.title: Tasks
panels.description:
One row for each system task, sorted with the most overdue task first (highest late factor).

* Runs on: the durable scheduler, a timer on the leader main, or a timer on every instance.
* Last success: the most recent success on any main in the last 2 days. A restart does not reset it.
* Late factor: last success age divided by the interval, with the interval counted as at least 60 seconds. 1 is normal. 2 or more means the task missed a run.
* Runs and Failures: counts in the selected time range. A daily task often shows 0 runs, so read Last success first.

Bad when: a cell is red.

panels.title: Failed Runs per Task
panels.description:
Failed runs by task, counted over a trailing window that spans several scrapes. The chart stays empty while every task succeeds.

Bad when: one task fails again and again. Read the error in the logs of the main that ran it.

targets.query:
import "array"

every = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > int(v: 1m) then v.windowPeriod else 1m

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and (r._field == "n8n_system_task_run_duration_seconds_count") and r.result == "failure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["task"], set: ${task:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["url"], set: ${instance:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "task"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["task"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "task"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: int(v: r._value + 0.5))}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)

panels.title: Run Duration p95
panels.description:
How long runs take, by task.

Bad when: p95 is near the interval of the task. The next run then overlaps or is skipped.

targets.query:
import "array"

every = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > int(v: 1m) then v.windowPeriod else 1m

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and (r._field == "n8n_system_task_run_duration_seconds_bucket"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["task"], set: ${task:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["url"], set: ${instance:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "le", "task"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with le: float(v: r.le)}))
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "task"])
  |> sort(columns: ["le"])
  |> histogramQuantile(quantile: 0.95)
  |> group(columns: ["task"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "task"])

panels.title: Runs in Progress
panels.description:
Runs that are in progress now, by task.

Bad when: a task stays above zero for longer than its p95 duration. That run is stuck.

panels.title: Skipped Runs (timers only)
panels.description:
Skipped runs by task and reason, counted over a trailing window that spans several scrapes. These runs came due on a timer but did not start. `overlap`: the previous run was still in progress. `provisioned_elsewhere`: the durable scheduler runs the task. `aborted` and `coalesced` are harmless. Durable tasks never appear here.

Bad when: `overlap` is steady. The runs take longer than the interval.

targets.query:
import "array"

every = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > int(v: 1m) then v.windowPeriod else 1m

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and (r._field == "n8n_system_task_runs_skipped_total"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["task"], set: ${task:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["url"], set: ${instance:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "task", "reason"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["task", "reason"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "task", "reason"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: int(v: r._value + 0.5))}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)

panels.title: Retries (timers only)
panels.description:
Retries after failed timer runs, by task, counted over a trailing window that spans several scrapes. Durable retries are on the Durable Scheduler dashboard.

Bad when: retries rise together with Failed Runs per Task.

panels.title: Time to Next Run
panels.description:
Time until the next run of each task. A healthy task draws a sawtooth. Durable tasks show their stored next run on n8n versions that export it. On older versions only timer tasks appear here.

Bad when: a line goes below zero and stays there. That task stopped. A durable task whose job is disabled leaves this chart instead, and counts in Unscheduled Tasks.

targets.query:
import "array"

every = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > int(v: 1m) then v.windowPeriod else 1m

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and (r._field == "n8n_system_task_next_run_timestamp_seconds"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["task"], set: ${task:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["url"], set: ${instance:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "task"])
  |> max()
  |> group(columns: ["task"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "task"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value - float(v: uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
